lessons.correction: Strengthen ground forces, continue production and technology development, and maintain economy.
lessons.mistake: Tempting to over-invest in technology while neglecting army size, risking falling behind in army strength.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when opponent's tech or army composition becomes clearer, or when your own tech milestones are reached.
lessons.title: Ground vs Ground: Avoid Overcommitting to Tech
lessons.when: Early-midgame, opponent shows ground posture with Zergling and Queen cues; your own ground posture with Zealot and Stalker cues.
lessons.why: Both sides ground-oriented, so a strong ground army and tech advantage are key to gaining an edge.

lessons.title: Ground vs Ground: Avoid Neglecting Economy
